items.title: RTX 5090 and M4 MacBook Air: Can It Game?
items.author: allenleee
items.summary: The RTX 5090 can technically be used with an M4 MacBook Air for gaming, but performance will be limited due to the MacBook's hardware constraints. The RTX 5090 offers superior gaming performance compared to the M4. Expect low frame rates and high power consumption.

items.title: Codex is now in the ChatGPT mobile app
items.author: mikeevans
items.summary: Codex is now available in the mobile version of the ChatGPT app. Users can start tasks, view changes, and manage pull requests on the go. This update was released recently.

items.title: Have a Coherent AI Policy
items.author: ai_critic
items.summary: An AI policy outlines principles for ethical AI use, mitigates risks, and aligns with organizational values and legal standards. It ensures responsible AI deployment and participation in societal discussions. A well-crafted policy is essential for managing AI risks effectively.

items.title: More than sixty percent of the United States is experiencing drought conditions
items.author: littlexsparkee
items.summary: As of May 2026, over 60 percent of the United States is experiencing drought conditions, with significant areas facing severe to extreme drought. This widespread drought affects millions of people and impacts agriculture and water supplies. The drought is one of the worst in recent history.

items.title: Ontario auditors find doctors' AI note takers routinely blow basic facts
items.author: sohkamyung
items.summary: Ontario auditors found that AI note-taking systems used by doctors often miss critical details and insert incorrect information. The AI systems also fabricated content not discussed by patients or clinicians. The auditor general emphasized the need for better testing to ensure accuracy.

items.title: Fossils show millipede and centipede ancestors evolved legs underwater
items.author: gmays
items.summary: Millipede and centipede ancestors evolved legs underwater, according to ancient sea fossils. This adaptation allowed them to transition to terrestrial environments. Fossil evidence supports this evolutionary transition.

items.title: 60fps Video on a CGA? – The GlyphBlaster
items.author: tambourine_man
items.summary: The GlyphBlaster enables 60fps video on a CGA display. It's a retro-hardware hack. Adafruit and Hacker News covered it.

items.title: AI is making me dumb
items.author: Eighth
items.summary: AI can reduce reliance on critical thinking by providing quick answers, but it doesn't inherently make people dumber. Usage varies, and some studies suggest a decline in critical thinking skills with heavy reliance on AI. However, AI also offers tools to enhance learning and problem-solving.

items.title: Saying Goodbye to one line of APL
items.author: tosh
items.summary: A one-line APL expression for computing visible faces in voxel chunks is being phased out. This change impacts data structures used in the computation. The update is significant for APL users.

items.title: LLM Policy for Rust Compiler
items.author: liyanage
items.summary: The Rust compiler benefits from Large Language Models (LLMs) to fix compilation errors, enhancing safety and accuracy. RustAssistant, a Microsoft tool, uses LLMs to achieve up to 74% accuracy in fixing Rust code errors. LLMs provide rapid feedback for generating functional Rust code.

items.title: Best "Brain" for Agents Is Just Versioned Folders of Markdown Files
items.author: murdockq
items.summary: Versioned folders of markdown files are a simple, effective way to manage AI agents. A single markdown file, `agents.md`, controls all AI actions. This method leverages plain text for easy updates and organization.

items.title: Elevated error rates on Opus 4.7
items.author: rob
items.summary: Elevated error rates on Opus 4.7 have been reported. The issue was minor and resolved within 24 minutes. No further incidents have been noted since.

items.title: I built a live map for tracking military aircraft activity worldwide
items.author: Anaxader
items.summary: Flightradar24 and Plane Finder offer real-time tracking of military aircraft globally. ADS-B.NL provides detailed military aircraft tracking and data storage. Global Weapons Tracking Portal lists various tools for monitoring military and civilian aircraft.

items.title: Bare-metal STM32: vector table, linker script, and startup code from scratch
items.author: lmilz
items.summary: For STM32 bare-metal, the vector table is placed in the `.isr_vector_table` section, the linker script defines memory regions, and startup code initializes the environment for `main()`.

items.title: Leaving the Physical World
items.author: andsoitis
items.summary: Leaving the physical world often involves out-of-body experiences or astral projection, where individuals report feeling detached from their bodies and perceiving surroundings differently. These experiences can include sensations of floating or traveling, but taste and touch are typically not reported.

items.title: WinUI 3 Performance: A Leap Forward
items.author: whatever3
items.summary: Microsoft claims a 25% performance boost in WinUI 3, aiming to make Windows more responsive, with optimizations becoming default in future updates. Performance improvements focus on reducing resource usage and enhancing app launch times.

items.title: A Claude Code and Codex Skill for Deliberate Skill Development
items.author: cdrnsf
items.summary: The Claude Code and Codex Skill enhances deliberate skill development by turning AI-assisted coding tasks into interactive learning exercises, promoting long-term skill retention and deeper understanding. It uses evidence-based learning techniques.

items.title: Parametric CAD Bench
items.author: handcrafted
items.summary: Parametric CAD benches are customizable, often 3D printed, and adaptable in size. They use software like Grasshopper for design. Vertico offers a parametric bench in concrete.
